versions.content: Meaning of ApplicationRuleBasedValueSpecification The purpose of the ApplicationRuleBasedValueSpecification is to provide means for a compact provision of values for DataPrototype s that otherwise would require a high volume (in terms of serialized ARXML) of e.g. initialization data. ApplicationRuleBasedValueSpecification may be used for Application- ArrayDataType , and also (if applicable) to the so-called Compound Primitive Data Type s.
